hero.label: Hero
hero.description: Page hero: rich heading & subheading, up to two CTAs, an optional CTA card (a picture, a title and a subtitle — the person to talk to, a partner, a badge) and an optional nested column area for composing extra content from any blocks.

rich_content.label: Rich content
rich_content.description: Generic prose section: an optional eyebrow, a heading and a rich body. For a picture beside the prose, put this block and an Image block in a Columns row — that is what carries the alt text, the crop and the mobile order.

options.h1: H1 — this section is the page title

animation_url.help: A JSON animation served by this site, e.g. /documents/animation.json

paragraph.label: Paragraph
paragraph.description: The simplest text block: a single rich-text body, no heading or media. Handy inside a column. The variant decides whether it reads as running prose or as a set-apart note.

button.label: Button
button.description: A single call-to-action button (label, link, style).

heading.label: Heading
heading.description: A standalone heading (text + level H1–H4) for structuring a column or section.

separator.label: Separator
separator.description: A horizontal divider with a visual style (default / wide line / dots).

video_section.label: Video section
video_section.description: Embed a video by URL with an optional heading and body copy.

features.label: Features / steps
features.description: Eyebrow, heading, intro and a repeater of numbered feature steps.

cta_banner.label: CTA banner
cta_banner.description: Copy-only call-to-action banner: eyebrow, heading, body, optional highlight badges, CTAs and a CTA card (a picture, a title and a subtitle — the person to talk to). Compose an image beside it with a Columns block.

promo_split.label: Promo split
promo_split.description: Two-column promo panel — brand-colored side with eyebrow, heading, body and one CTA; a photo bleeding to the edge on the other (reverse flips sides).

options.h1: H1 — this section is the page title

pricing_teaser.label: Pricing teaser
pricing_teaser.description: Pricing teaser (no price data) — intro copy plus cards that deep-link to /pricing.

testimonials.label: Testimonials
testimonials.description: References and orders shared Testimonial items (collection-ref); the API resolves them inline per locale.

component_ref.label: Global component
component_ref.description: Embeds a reusable global Component (footer, default CTA, services menu) inline by reference.

section_teaser.label: Section teaser
section_teaser.description: Lists the newest items from a chosen section as cards or a list; the API resolves the items inline per locale.

documents.label: Documents
documents.description: A titled list of downloadable documents from the Files library; each row links to its file.

cards.label: Cards
cards.description: A row of items — icon or image, label, optional value and link — laid out as tiles, cards, numbered steps, bare figures or a picture-led bento grid. Free-form by design: for opening hours as a day/time table use Opening hours, for an address-and-phone section use Contact — those two lay those facts out for you.

gallery.label: Gallery
gallery.description: A grid of photos with an optional heading and a note beside it. Each image carries its own alt text.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.description: Question/answer list, rendered as a collapsible accordion (optionally with the first answer already open) or as an always-open list. An optional CTA sits inline beside the heading — for the place people should go when the answer is not here (a client portal, the contact form).

team.label: Team
team.description: A grid of person cards (photo, name, role) with an optional anchor id.

image_block.label: Image
image_block.description: A single inline image (media upload) with alt, caption, alignment and responsive sizing (global + mobile/desktop overrides).

button_group.label: Button group
button_group.description: A row of CTA buttons (primary / outline) placed inline in the content flow.

pricing_table.label: Pricing table
pricing_table.description: Selects and orders shared Plan items (collection-ref) as cards; the billing toggle groups them into tabs by billing type, and the width setting gives a four-card set room to breathe.

animation_url.help: A JSON animation served by this site, e.g. /documents/animation.json

options.default: Default (each blurb sets its own height)
options.fixed: Fixed (prices line up across the cards)

options.small: Small (a long price stays on one line)

tab_labels.help: Renames the billing-toggle buttons. Leave empty to use the default names.

highlights.label: Highlights (grouped list)
highlights.description: Grouped list with free-text values — category cards of priced items, plus optional links and a footnote (menu, price list, package tiers…).

quote.label: Quote
quote.description: A single inline press/social-proof quote: source tag, headline, lede, pull-quote, attribution, one source link and an image.

source_tag.help: A small label above the headline saying where this came from, e.g. “Press · Nussbaum Medien”. Plain text — the link to the article is the pair of fields further down.

headline.help: The headline of the article being quoted — its words, not your own.

lede.help: The one line that sits under the headline and sets the scene, e.g. “The mayor stopped by in person”.

quote.help: The passage being quoted. It takes more than one paragraph, so a closing thought of your own belongs here as a second paragraph — not in Attribution.

attribution.help: Who said it, e.g. “Jordan Fields, Lead Engineer”. Not a takeaway or a closing line — those go in the quote above.

source_link_label.help: The wording of the link to the original, e.g. “Read more on nussbaum.de”.

source_link_href.help: The full address of the article, starting with https:// — this field is not checked, so a typo here fails silently.

alt.help: What the photo shows, for readers using a screen reader. Describe the picture, do not repeat the headline.

hours.label: Opening hours
hours.description: Opening-hours contact section — eyebrow, heading, a repeater of day/hours rows and a footnote.

map.label: Map embed
map.description: A standalone, composable map embed (GDPR-relevant; a renderer may consent-gate it).

contact.label: Contact
contact.description: Contact / NAP block — address, maps link and phone (display + E.164 for tel:).

custom_html.label: Custom HTML
custom_html.description: Escape hatch for third-party markup no other block covers — an embed, an iframe, a widget script. Inserted as-is, so anything put here stops being CMS content: it cannot be edited in the page builder, translated, themed by branding or classified for cookie consent. Do not lay out a page with it — compose it from real blocks instead (get_blocks_schema lists them).

columns.label: Columns
columns.description: Layout container — pick a column preset and drop any block (except Columns) into each column (depth-1).

options.prose: Prose measure (line up with the text band above)

tabs.label: Tabs
tabs.description: Tabbed content: a set of named tabs, each holding its own blocks (text, buttons, images, …). Rendered as an accessible tab strip on the frontend; the tab anchor is derived from its name.
